rows.amal_said: English. What's one year? ... (chat) santain
rows.why: Dual drill: asked for 'two years' he answered in English; she said 'English', prompted with 'what's one year?' and the chat gives santain; sheet: 'year (2 years/years) | Sane | سنة (سنتين'.

rows.medi_said: [speaking Arabic] ... It took me two hours to make this table.
rows.amal_said: So now أخلص just أعمل. ... خلصت. ... أعمل or أخلص just one. Which one؟ ... أخلص.
rows.why: He stacked two verbs ('to finish to make this table'); she told him to use just one and settled on أخلص; chat 'la-a6alless haadi el-taawla'.
